# Behavioral matrix for src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts's RULES.
# Format: <ruleName> :: <ok|flag> :: <command>
# '#' comments and blank lines are ignored. US-001 (CAM-388) seeds the
# frozen-comparand and rotating-artifact-target rows this story's acceptance
# criteria depend on; a future story broadens the matrix to the other rules.
frozen-comparand :: ok :: bun -e 'const cs=["test $X -eq 41","test $X -ge 41"];for(const c of cs){console.log(c)}'
frozen-comparand :: ok :: grep -qF 'test $(git grep -c PATTERN mainbranch:file.ts) -eq 1' test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $(wc -l < scripts/cam/patterns.md) -eq 42
frozen-comparand :: flag :: sh -c 'test $(wc -l < scripts/cam/patterns.md) -eq 42'
rotating-artifact-target :: flag :: cat 'scripts/cam/handoff.json' | grep -q retryBaseMs
